legal.avertissementTexte: This text has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. It describes the service accurately, but it must be validated before any public launch.

conditions.objetTexte: DropLink lets a seller create a private page per order, upload photos and videos to it, attach a tracking number, and share the link with their customer. The recipient of the link has no account and creates none.
conditions.roleTexte: We host content uploaded by sellers. We do not produce it, select it, or review it in advance. Each seller remains solely responsible for what they upload and for holding the rights to share it.
conditions.interditTexte: Uploading unlawful content, content infringing the rights of a third party, or content you do not hold the rights to. Using the service to share third-party personal data without a legal basis. Attempting to access another account's data.
conditions.retraitTexte: We may suspend an account whose content is reported as manifestly unlawful. Suspension immediately makes all of the account's public pages unreachable. It is reversible: reactivation restores the pages on the same links.
conditions.responsabiliteTexte: The service is provided as is, free of charge, during its launch phase. Tracking information comes from carriers and we cannot guarantee its accuracy or freshness.
conditions.paiementTexte: DropLink processes no payments, neither between a seller and their customer nor for use of the service. We are not a payment intermediary and take no part in any commercial transaction.

confidentialite.collecteTexte: For a seller: their email address, the declared account type, the language, and the content they upload. For a visitor to a public page: a salted, irreversible fingerprint of their IP address and browser, used only to count one visit per visitor per day.
confidentialite.pasDeCompteTexte: The name shown on a page is free text entered by the seller. It is not an account, it is not a user lookup, and it creates no profile with us.
confidentialite.indexationTexte: Order pages carry a no-index directive, are listed nowhere, and are reachable only through their link. We publish no rich preview of these pages: a preview would show the content inside the conversation, therefore to people who never open the link.
confidentialite.conservationTexte: Raw carrier responses are purged 90 days after the parcel's last movement, not after its creation: a stuck parcel is the one whose history matters most.
confidentialite.droitsTexte: You may request access to, correction of, or erasure of your data, as well as its portability. Data is hosted in the European Union.

signalement.intro: If content hosted on DropLink appears unlawful to you or infringes your rights, write to us.
signalement.quoi1: The exact link to the page concerned.
signalement.quoi2: A description of the disputed content and where it appears on the page.
signalement.quoi3: The legal grounds, and your contact details so we can reply.
signalement.suiteTexte: We acknowledge receipt, review the report, and may suspend the account concerned. A suspension immediately makes all of its public pages unreachable.
signalement.descriptionExemple: Describe the content, where it appears on the page, and the legal grounds.
signalement.piecesTexte: Attach your screenshots directly to the email: they cannot travel through this form.
signalement.ouvreMessagerie: The button opens your mail app with the message pre-filled. You send it yourself.
signalement.adresseDirecte: You can also write directly to

inscription.ceQuiSuit1: You name your shop and pick your colour.
inscription.ceQuiSuit2: You create your first order and drop in your photos.
inscription.ceQuiSuit3: You send a single link to your customer.

marque.couleurAide: It carries the buttons and markers on your customers' page.
marque.couleurAjustee: On your customers' page, text sitting on this colour is darkened or lightened slightly so it stays readable. Your colour itself is not changed.
marque.erreurCouleur: Enter six digits or letters preceded by a hash, for example #0058be.
marque.pageAide: Two settings that only affect what the person receiving the link sees.
marque.langueAide: Your customers' language, not yours: they do not choose it when they open the link. The language of this screen is set separately.
marque.filigraneLabel: Show my shop name on the photos
marque.filigraneAide: The name appears over the photos and videos. It discourages reuse but does not prevent it: the name is not burned into the file.
marque.filigraneSansNom: Give your shop a name first: without one there is nothing to write on the photos.
marque.apercuAide: What your customer sees, with your current settings.
marque.apercuLangue: This page will be shown in {langue}.

revocation.jeComprends: I understand the old link will permanently stop working.

qc.texte: Do these photos match what you expected?
qc.refuse: A problem has been reported on this order. The seller has been notified.
qc.echec: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.

suivi.silence: The parcel is registered and tracked. Such a delay is not unusual at customs — we keep querying the carrier every day.
suivi.arrete: The carrier no longer reports on this number. Contact the seller if nothing has arrived.

comptes.sousTitre: Every visit to this page is recorded with your email and the time.

journal.sousTitre: What administrators have viewed or changed. Entries cannot be edited or deleted, and outlive the accounts they describe.

fiche.volumesAide: Volumes, not content: they are enough to decide, and the content belongs to the seller and their customers.

suspension.aideSuspension: Its public pages stop being served immediately. Its links are not destroyed: reactivating restores them exactly as they were.
suspension.aideReactivation: Its pages become reachable again on the very links already sent to its customers.
suspension.motifAide: At least {n} characters. It appears in plain text in the audit log, and it is what will be read back if the decision is challenged.
suspension.recopier: Retype the account address to confirm
suspension.collageAide: Pasting is disabled: retyping the address is what makes sure you are suspending the right account.
suspension.collageRefuse: Paste refused. Retype the address by hand: it is the one moment when you actually check which account is targeted.

erreur.confirmation: The address you retyped does not match this account.

panneau.aucuneAlerte: No alerts. Nothing is over the thresholds, and background tasks are beating normally.

alerte.colis_au_dessus_du_seuil: An account is over the parcel registration threshold this month
alerte.veilleur_en_retard: A background task has not beaten for too long

panneau.colisFacturesAide: This is the only item the tracking provider bills. {abandonnes} abandoned this month.
panneau.stockageAide: Sum of the sizes measured server-side on upload, across all accounts. The per-shop breakdown is on the Shops screen.
panneau.tachesJamaisDeployees: No task has ever beaten. This is not a failure: nothing has been deployed yet.
panneau.seuilsEnCours: Thresholds in force: {colis} parcels per account per month, {minutes} minutes without a beat.

parametres.sousTitre: The thresholds the product actually reads. Every change is recorded with the previous and new value, your email and the time.
parametres.secretsAide: Secrets are not set here: API keys, the scheduler secret and the service key stay in the server environment. A value stored in the database would be readable by anyone with access to it — acceptable for a threshold, never for a key.

origine.jamaisDecide: Default value: nobody has ever changed it.
origine.auteurParti: Changed on {date}. The account that changed it no longer exists.

seuil_colis_par_compte.aide: Number of parcels registered in the month above which the account appears in the panel alerts. This is the only counter in the product that matches an invoice.

plafond_commandes_mensuel.aide: Orders a single account may create in a month. Beyond that, creation is REFUSED: this is the only threshold in the product that blocks a write, and the seller would learn about it from their customer. Keep it above real usage — a supplier creates around 870 a month.

retard_veilleur_minutes.titre: Report a task as late after
retard_veilleur_minutes.aide: Minutes without a heartbeat after which a background task is reported as late. Too low, and the alert would describe the normal cadence rather than a failure.

erreur.refuse: You are not allowed to change this setting.
erreur.panne: Could not save. The setting is unchanged.

boutiques.sousTitre: What each account takes up, sorted by storage. This screen shows no content: no customer name, no reference, no notes. Every view is recorded with your email and the time.

surveillance.sousTitre: What the product actually measures. The figures it does not measure are named below rather than left out: a silent screen would suggest they are being watched.
surveillance.nonMesureAide: Nothing currently records these figures. They will appear here together with the mechanism that measures them, never before: one invented number on this screen would cast doubt on all the others.

admin.traceTexte: Every read of a seller’s data is written to the audit log.

erreurs.titre: This screen could not be displayed
erreurs.texte: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is untouched: nothing was saved or deleted.
